title: Desktop updates
summary: Describes desktop app update behaviour: in-app updates only for verified signed Mac builds, installer downloads otherwise, and the optional Mac signing and notarization setup.
notes: Type SPEC taken from MANIFEST_TYPE (manifest_override true). Content is operational/configuration (update channels, signing secrets, release gating) rather than API or schema contracts, so content signals are weak. No internal doc links; only external URLs (electron-builder, Apple notarization) are referenced, which are not recorded in cross_refs. Output filename uses placeholder suffix NOHASH because the SHA-256 of the source path could not be computed with the tools available (no shell access). cross_refs cleared on 2026-11-14 by owner decision: they were see-also links, not dependencies.
